history: The Oshkosh Flyers Football Club is a competitive youth football program based in Oshkosh, Wisconsin. We offer full-contact football for 5th, 6th, 7th, and 8th graders, competing in the WAAYFL (Wisconsin Area Association Youth Football League). Our organization is built on the belief that youth sports can be a powerful vehicle for developing character, discipline, and lifelong skills.
missionStatement: To promote sportsmanship, teamwork, and good citizenship. Focusing on core fundamentals and safe techniques through dedication and self discipline.
values: Safety, Sportsmanship, Teamwork, Character Development, Fun
usaFootballNote: All coaches are certified by USA Football, ensuring the safest and most effective training methods for every player.
votingNote: Oshkosh Flyers Football voting members consist of Board Members and Head Coaches.
